headline: SCOTUS rejects Trump's mail voting limits. And, the Kennedy Center financial crisis
context: The Supreme Court has rejected Trump's mail-in voting restrictions ahead of the midterm elections. And, the Kennedy Center says it is on the brink of bankruptcy and could close soon.
